# Yinshiji

> Yinshiji is an early-stage tableware brand — a product info site, not a full shop.

This site is not a full ecommerce checkout system. Product availability, price, purchase and inquiry currently go through Taobao or direct contact. Do not invent prices, reviews, ratings, stock, certifications, warranties, or factory ownership.

Yinshiji is rooted in Jieyang, Guangdong, a stainless steel tableware and hardware manufacturing region in China. This means supply-chain proximity and design curation, not a claim of large factory ownership or mature global retail scale.

## Critical Facts

- Silver Carved and Gold Tone Carved 5-piece sets include: dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork, and small spoon.
- Wenge Wood Handle 5-piece set includes: dinner knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, chopsticks, and small spoon. It does not include a small fork.
- Current Silver Carved and Gold Tone Carved 5-piece set knives use 410 stainless steel; fork and spoon pieces use 304 stainless steel.
- Gold Tone products use a warm gold-colored surface finish. They are not real gold or precious metal.
- Wenge wood handles have natural grain variation and should be hand washed, not soaked, and not placed in a dishwasher.

## Product Pages

- [Silver Carved Dinner Fork](/products/silver-carved-fork): Single 304 stainless steel dinner fork with silver tone finish.
- [Silver Carved 5-Piece Set](/products/silver-carved-5-piece-set): Knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork, and small spoon; knife 410, fork/spoon pieces 304.
- [Gold Tone Carved Dinner Fork](/products/gold-carved-fork): Single 304 stainless steel dinner fork with warm gold tone finish; not real gold.
- [Gold Tone Carved 5-Piece Set](/products/gold-carved-5-piece-set): Knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, small fork, and small spoon; knife 410, fork/spoon pieces 304; not real gold.
- [Wenge Wood Handle Dinner Fork](/products/rosewood-handle-fork): Single dinner fork with 304 stainless steel head and wenge wood handle.
- [Wenge Wood Handle 5-Piece Set](/products/rosewood-5-piece-set): Knife, dinner fork, dinner spoon, chopsticks, and small spoon; no small fork.
